d: Addressing the Save Democracy, Remove Anarchy rally along Tank Bund in Hyderabad, Union Home Minister Amit Shah launched a sharp attack on Congress leader Rahul Gandhi following the opposition's mock Parliament demonstration. Shah asserted that Rahul Gandhi could only fulfill his prime ministerial ambitions inside a mock Parliament, claiming he would never become Prime Minister in real life due to repeated electoral rejections by the Indian public.
